shared_diagram_prompt: Create an academic scientific infographic for a cybersecurity research guide. White background, crisp publication quality, wide landscape composition about 3:2. Restrained navy typography and thin dark connectors, blue input panels, amber design/gates, green methods/allowed, coral held/rejected, purple evaluation, teal outputs. Attractive precise diagram with small meaningful technical icons, generous whitespace, clearly separated panels and arrowheads. Readable large labels, exact spelling, no decorative robot heads, no gradients, no title, no figure number, no dates, no watermark. Do not invent measured results.

prompts.2: Create a three-panel photorealistic critical infrastructure image strip, very wide aspect ratio 3:1, each of three equal panels clearly separated by narrow white gutters. Left panel a modern water treatment facility with circular clarifier tanks, pipes and pump building seen at slight aerial angle. Center panel electricity substation with transformers, insulators, switchgear and transmission pylons in daylight. Right panel a modern manufacturing production hall with robotic assembly and conveyor equipment, no people or brand logos. These are generic illustrative facilities, not identifiable actual sites. Natural documentary photographic style, physically plausible engineering equipment, calm neutral daylight, crisp high detail. No text anywhere, no dates, no watermark, no cybersecurity overlays. Must remain realistic, no fantasy futuristic elements.
prompts.3: Digital-twin and governed agent research architecture. Top row: 'Released evidence' (assets, flows, events) arrow to 'Digital twin' (state, behavior, topology); 'Knowledge context' (graph, CTI, provenance) also feeds next stage. Twin and knowledge feed 'Agent reasoning and proposed plan'. Downward arrow to independent amber 'Policy gate' (tool allow-list, risk, stop rules). Branch to green 'Eligible offline action' (mock tool or twin experiment) and coral 'Hold or human review'. Both lead to teal 'Auditable outcome record'. Dashed feedback from outcome back to digital twin labelled 'Evaluated feedback'. Keep policy gate visibly external to agent. Use model/graph/database/tool/ledger technical icons.
prompts.4: Controlled evidence manipulation experiment: 'Frozen graph / CTI subset' feeds amber 'Threat model and perturbation budget'. Split into grey 'Clean evidence' and green 'Perturbed evidence', each feeding an identical analytical model. Rejoin at purple 'Compare correctness and evidence support', then teal 'Report degradation and abstention'. Show graph nodes with some perturbed relations and a comparison icon. Do not use numerical scores.
prompts.5: Minimal precise cross-sector transfer diagram, large readable text. Use EXACTLY six boxes and ONLY these labels: blue top-left 'Released industrial evidence'; blue top-right 'Target-sector evidence'; green below left 'Fixed method and baseline'; amber below right 'Compatibility assessment'; purple bottom-center 'Independent target-sector validation'; teal below purple 'Bounded transfer claim'. Arrows top-left to green, top-right to amber, green and amber to purple, purple to teal. No extra labels, no list of sectors, no data examples, no incident records, no numerical results. Small unlabeled database icon, small unlabeled check icon only. Balanced 3:2 composition.
prompts.6: Evidence-to-experiment decision workflow: 'Frozen dataset and research question' -> 'Audit labels, groups and duplicate overlap' -> branching diamond 'Verified target?'. Yes to 'Supervised comparison'; No to 'Exploratory or controlled study'. Rejoin at 'Train-only fitting and locked evaluation', then 'Uncertainty and provenance'. Include dataset stack, group split and magnifying glass icons.
prompts.7: Monitoring placement comparison. Blue 'Asset / zone tables + 120 declared flows' represented as small network separated by zone boundaries. Amber 'Validate joins and fix monitoring budget'. Split to grey 'Degree / criticality baseline' and green 'Boundary-aware selection'. Rejoin to purple 'Coverage, cost and uncovered assets'. Teal 'Budget and missing-join sensitivity'. Show selected monitoring nodes with a different outline, no numeric result.
prompts.8: Minimal precise research split comparison, no domain relation examples. EXACT boxes and labels: blue top 'Typed nodes and relation rules'; amber below 'Training graph: split before features'; split arrows to grey left 'Type-constrained frequency' and green right 'Typed graph model'; both feed purple below 'Same candidates and filtered ranks'; teal bottom 'Audit false links and risk assumptions'. Separate small blue panel on far right 'Held-out edges' with one arrow ONLY into the purple evaluation panel, NOT into either model. Place a red crossed-out line between held-out edges and training graph labeled 'No leakage'. No CVE/CWE/CAPEC relations or graph relation names anywhere. Only abstract unlabelled node-edge motif within input panel. High clarity arrow direction is essential.
prompts.9: Grounded CTI evaluation. Blue 'Grouped CTI prompts' with reference answers hidden. Amber 'Freeze model, prompts and evidence'. Branch grey 'Same LLM: no retrieval' versus green 'Same LLM: graph grounding'. Both feed purple 'Mapping accuracy and evidence support'. Teal 'Coverage, abstention and disagreements'. Small graph, evidence-document and identifier icons. Explicit crossed boundary labelled 'Reference answers excluded'.
prompts.10: Minimal scientific experiment workflow with EXACTLY six main boxes and ONLY these labels: blue top '358 unique instruction-output pairs'; amber 'Group templates and freeze splits'; branch grey 'Fixed model and prompt' and green 'Adapted model: training only'; join purple 'Held-out evaluation: syntax, schema, semantics'; teal 'Errors, split IDs and model configuration'. Add ONE small separate blue box 'Training split' feeding ONLY adapted model. Add ONE small separate blue box 'Test prompts' feeding BOTH fixed model and adapted model with dashed arrows explicitly labelled 'Inference only'. No development input box. No test arrow into Training split. No crossed line at evaluation. No extra labels, no extra pipeline, no numerical scores. All text exact. Small code and database icons only.
prompts.11: Controlled synthetic anomaly evaluation. Blue 'Generated protocol records'. Amber 'Group split, injection rule and seed'. Split grey 'Threshold baseline' versus green 'Multivariate anomaly detector'. Rejoin purple 'Evaluate injected labels and severity'. Teal 'Protocol sensitivity and synthetic-only scope'. Include stylized time-series with no numeric axes or fabricated measurement, perturbation magnifying glass, protocol log icons. Explicit small badge 'Derived labels'.
prompts.12: Sequence analysis workflow. Exact main labels: '29 pseudonymized event traces' -> 'Whole-trace split' -> two branches 'Transition baseline' and 'Sequence anomaly model' -> 'Label availability check' -> 'Trace-level evaluation and review'. Under label check show two small alternatives 'Verified labels' and 'Exploratory scores'. Technical icons event-sequence, split traces, sequence model. No fake performance charts. Include small label 'Fit encoders on training traces only'. Never treat ok as attack label.
prompts.13: Governed agent decision evaluation. Blue 'Scenario inputs' with 'Expected outputs hidden'. Purple 'Agent proposal'. Amber diamond 'Catalog, risk and stop checks'. Branch green 'Allow local mock action' and coral 'Hold, stop or abstain'. Both lead purple 'Compare actual and expected decisions' then teal 'Audit tools, stopping and loops'. Include small tool catalog, shield, stop and audit icons. Exactly these words. No actual external attack execution. Clearly external independent policy gate.
prompts.14: Minimal academic flow diagram. Use ONLY these exact labels, no sublabels or extra examples: three blue input boxes 'Inventory', 'Knowledge graph', 'Observations'; converge into amber 'Validate identity and time mappings'; diamond 'Supported join?'; branch green 'Assemble cited evidence chain' and coral 'Isolate and request review'; rejoin purple 'Human review and baseline comparison'; teal final 'Coverage, decision quality and audit trail'. Branches labelled Yes and No. Small unlabeled abstract icons inside boxes. Do not enumerate source fields, no user reports, no incident claims, no metrics.
